purpose: Handoff index for building the web visualization (Gemini 3.8). All paths are repo-relative.
demo_player: dtap/demo/player.html (generated by dtap/make_player.py; v13-first multi-scenario player with split screen follow)

conventions.trajectory.json: DTAP per-task trajectory: task_info / traj_info / trajectory[]. Agent steps carry metadata.server and tool_params; tool steps carry the result state.
conventions.judge_result.json: verdict: attack_success, attack_metadata.surface (googledocs_share | gmail_send), attack_metadata.shared_documents, shared_with.
conventions.accept_step: agent action accept_invitation(event_id=...) - the calendar acceptance step.

headline.ablation_takeaway: The vendor-shared docs are load-bearing (nodocs 0/2); the calendar invitation and emails are optional for luna (nocal 2/2, nogmail 1/2).
